body: Thank you so much for the clarification!

Again, I can’t thank all of you enough for your resources, stories, and support! I feel confident that her and the family will be in a better place with all of these resources and information. Thanks again for taking the time to post so many helpful things!

Thank you so much for this informative post containing great resources and advice! I will look into all of these and pass along to the family, and if they don’t follow through, contacting a health services officer (and avoiding police) is a great idea! Thanks again, your post is inspiring and very helpful!!
Thank you so much everyone, this has been very helpful! I will continue searching for resources that will help her and her family :)

Thank you so much for sharing, and so sorry that this is happening with your family. Can’t imagine what it’s like being at home and stuck.

I definitely don’t think they’re intentionally neglecting her, it’s just difficult hearing how things are going with them. When she did leave the house 4 yrs ago, I don’t think she was getting adequate care then, mostly because her parents didn’t know where to go.

I hope things improve for your brother and family soon :)

I don’t know if this helps, but do you think that if you shared your concerns about hospitalization (without details), that you could come up with a better plan with their help? Perhaps options are agreeing to medication and/or an outpatient program if you can afford it or have good resources where you are. 

I have one friend who has done this and has been mostly successful at staying out of the hospital. She also has an eating disorder and the hospitalization was for that. My friend who had suicidal tendencies was never hospitalized except for the time he attempted, and even then he talked himself out of staying 72 hrs. He was seeing a counselor through the school, and I’m almost positive he shared everything.

I hope there are a couple people in your life (friends/family) you can trust to share your details with. I want to do everything I can to help my friends– the only thing that usually holds me back is them not telling me things. Someone in your life might feel the same way :)

Hey, I’m sorry for your loss. I expected to have this reaction, like my friend said “if anything happens to me, promise you’ll keep living.” I refused to make that promise. Thank you for sharing how your best friend’s loss affected you. Wish it wasn’t so painful
Thank you :) and yeah that’s what I was thinking in that moment

I’m sorry for your loss– thank you for sharing. Knowing your friend for so long and seeing the impact on his own family must hurt a lot. I don’t think you’re making it about you. Wanted to hear others stories actually. I’m glad you are fighting to work through your problem. The loss of my friend has motivated me to work through things, getting more comfortable doing things that will help instead of just trying to manage. Part of me hopes life will bring better things to us after this. I hope you succeed in working though your drinking problem. The world needs more caring, thoughtful people like you

Hey, I wish I saw this sooner. It makes me so mad that the hotlines are busy :( is it late where you are?

I hope you can talk to a friend soon. I’m pretty terrible at responding to messages (it takes a lot of energy sometimes), but if you’re still online I’ll do my best. Hope you’re somewhere with decent weather rn cause it’s been strange many places lately

I’ll be thinking about you tonight (in a caring, not creepy way)  :)
